recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow build-scope source fix that completes the accepted FHIR-15709 narrative alignment without disturbing later CompositionStatus terminology decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-15709 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It reported that the Composition Status Codes narrative listed preliminary, final, appended, amended, and retracted while Composition.status was required-bound to CompositionStatus values using entered-in-error rather than retracted; the accepted resolution was to update the narrative and remove the hand-written status-code table.
initial_application: svn 14514 / git b1e621c777 replaced the hand-written table in source/composition/composition-introduction.xml with the generated composition-status codelist and changed explicit status references from retracted to entered-in-error, but two nearby references to retracted compositions remained in the active status narrative.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini, and composition-introduction.xml is current Composition page narrative source. Later FHIR-37403 expanded CompositionStatus to align with DiagnosticReport and is already represented on the combined branch, so this reconciliation preserves the current generated codelist while removing the obsolete retracted wording.
reconciliation: Changed the two remaining narrative references from documents based on or derived from retracted compositions to documents based on or derived from compositions marked entered-in-error.
source_changes: source/composition/composition-introduction.xml: replaced two stale uses of "retracted compositions" with references to compositions marked entered-in-error.
